title: Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning Using Routed Ensembles and Trajectory Attribution
abstract: arXiv:2610.35733v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-objective reinforcement learning is a fundamental problem for modern AI, with applications spanning post-training, reasoning models, and robotic control. A central challenge is to learn policies that balance competing objectives, such as helpfulness versus honesty in safety and alignment, or speed versus energy in robotics. The optimal policy can vary sharply with objective-weighting combinations, and the extent of this variation depends crucially on the degree of conflict among objectives, making per-preference policy learning sample-inefficient. In this paper, we introduce objective-conflict coefficients and derive near-optimal regret bounds for online settings using this measure, thereby quantifying the impact of misalignment on learning efficiency. translated_title: 基于路由集成与轨迹归因的多目标强化学习
translated_abstract: 多目标强化学习是现代人工智能的一个基本问题，其应用涵盖后训练、推理模型和机器人控制等领域。一个核心挑战是学习能够平衡相互竞争目标的策略，例如安全与对齐中的有用性与诚实性之间的权衡，或机器人技术中的速度与能耗之间的权衡。最优策略会随目标权重组合的变化而急剧改变，而这种变化的程度关键取决于目标之间的冲突程度，这使得针对每种偏好单独学习策略的样本效率十分低下。在本文中，我们引入了目标冲突系数，并利用这一度量在在线设置下推导出接近最优的遗憾界，从而量化了目标间不一致对学习效率的影响。随后，我们设计了路由集成策略学习算法，该算法维护一小组基础策略，并动态地将轨迹路由到具有最高潜力的策略……
tldr: 本文提出目标冲突系数来量化多目标强化学习中目标冲突对学习效率的影响并给出近最优遗憾界，同时设计了路由集成策略学习算法，通过维护少量基础策略并动态路由轨迹来实现样本高效的多目标策略学习。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces objective-conflict coefficients to quantify how conflicts among objectives affect learning efficiency with near-optimal regret bounds, and proposes routed ensemble policy learning, which maintains a small set of basis policies and dynamically routes trajectories for sample-efficient multi-objective reinforcement learning.
